title: ::: K-IG 교육 영어듣기훈련프로그램 | 기초2 | 제 001 회 강의 :::
label: [ K-IG 교육 Reading 118 ]

blocks.text: More frequent use of computers will create a serious danger to our health. First of all, more people will have to wear glasses, because always staring at computer screens is likely to damage our eyes. Sitting at computer desks for hours can also cause damage to our backs. In addition, we won't get enough exercise, for we will often be forced to spend a long period of time at the computers. The future will be a lonely place to live because of computers. We won't be going to the supermarket, or even to school any more. Everyday goods and even education will come to us on-line. In addition, we will talk with one another using the computer. All of these will make us less human, in that the computer will take away our opportunities to meet for true human relationships.

readingSentences.english: More frequent use of computers will create a serious danger to our health.
readingSentences.korean: 컴퓨터를 더 자주 쓰면 건강에 심각한 위험이 생길 것이다.

readingSentences.english: First of all, more people will have to wear glasses, because always staring at computer screens is likely to damage our eyes.
readingSentences.korean: 우선 컴퓨터 화면을 늘 쳐다보면 눈이 상하기 쉬우므로 안경을 써야 하는 사람이 더 많아질 것이다.

readingSentences.english: Sitting at computer desks for hours can also cause damage to our backs.
readingSentences.korean: 몇 시간씩 컴퓨터 책상 앞에 앉아 있으면 허리에도 무리가 갈 수 있다.

readingSentences.english: In addition, we won't get enough exercise, for we will often be forced to spend a long period of time at the computers.
readingSentences.korean: 게다가 컴퓨터 앞에서 오랜 시간을 보내야 하는 일이 잦아 운동도 충분히 하지 못할 것이다.

readingSentences.english: The future will be a lonely place to live because of computers.
readingSentences.korean: 컴퓨터 때문에 미래는 외로운 곳이 될 것이다.

readingSentences.english: We won't be going to the supermarket, or even to school any more.
readingSentences.korean: 우리는 더 이상 슈퍼마켓에도, 심지어 학교에도 가지 않을 것이다.

readingSentences.english: Everyday goods and even education will come to us on-line.
readingSentences.korean: 생필품과 교육까지도 온라인으로 우리에게 올 것이다.

readingSentences.english: In addition, we will talk with one another using the computer.
readingSentences.korean: 게다가 우리는 컴퓨터를 이용해 서로 대화할 것이다.

readingSentences.english: All of these will make us less human, in that the computer will take away our opportunities to meet for true human relationships.
readingSentences.korean: 컴퓨터가 진정한 인간관계를 위해 만날 기회를 빼앗는다는 점에서, 이 모든 것은 우리를 덜 인간적으로 만들 것이다.
